dependencies_note: Python standard library only (json, sys, platform). No sympy, no sage, no gmpy2, no third-party p-adic or elliptic-curve library. All arithmetic is CPython arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic.
floating_point_note: No floating-point value is computed, stored or compared for any p-adic quantity anywhere in the implementation.
randomness: None. The computation is fully deterministic: no seed, no RNG call, no hash-order dependence in any reported value. The two instances and the (r, e) sweep grid are fixed by the frozen specification.
